scan_level_features.name: sat_observation_available
scan_level_features.definition: 1 if validated HDF and at least one valid station or 25 km CMK pixel; else 0. Missing file stays 0 with other fields null.

scan_level_features.name: sat_observation_time_utc
scan_level_features.definition: Decoded /time (minutes since 2000-01-01 00:00:00). Scan time, not an hour.

scan_level_features.name: sat_cloud_mask_at_station
scan_level_features.definition: Official CMK flag_value of nearest valid pixel to station. Null if none. Do not recode missing to 0.

scan_level_features.name: sat_valid_pixel_count_25km
scan_level_features.definition: Count of valid CMK pixels within 25 km haversine. Null if file missing.

scan_level_features.name: sat_clear_fraction_25km
scan_level_features.definition: Fraction of valid 25 km pixels with CMK in {0, 2}. Null if no valid pixels or observation unavailable.

scan_level_features.name: sat_cloudy_fraction_25km
scan_level_features.definition: Fraction of valid 25 km pixels with CMK in {1, 3}. Null if no valid pixels or observation unavailable.

temporal_matching_future_hourly_join.statement: Let T be the hourly atmospheric timestamp [T, T+1h). Let S be decoded /time UTC. Attach a granule to T only if T <= S < T+1h AND (if parseable) acquisition [start,end] overlaps [T, T+1h). Do not broadcast a scan to any other hour. If none match: sat_observation_available=0 and remaining satellite fields null, never 0-filled. If several match: keep S closest to T (tie: smaller gId).

deferred.temporal_change_reason: MVP scans are thinned and irregular; one granule missing. Deltas are not scientifically supported yet.
